Hovering over or moving keyboard focus onto an enabled button.
Pressing a regular button across the title screen, menus, Base, and combat HUD. Some actions also play a dedicated cue.
Pressing a toggle-mode button, including checkboxes and toggle controls.
Changing a focused slider, including the SFX and Music volume sliders.
Opening the run menu or Settings, switching Base tabs, and opening training or compost confirmation dialogs.
Closing the run menu or going back from Settings, including keyboard Back/Escape.
Rejected actions shown by ActionFeedback, such as an unaffordable action. Hovering a rejection preview stays silent.
Selecting a starter-package card or a Seal offer before confirming the choice.
Rearranging Nursery stock, or moving and swapping units between squad and bench slots.
Successfully buying fertilizer or a mutation into stock. Applying a shop item directly to a plot uses its application cue.
Successfully selling a spore, fertilizer, or mutation from Nursery stock.
Successfully rerolling the Nursery shop, Scout army, or mid-run Seal offers.
Locking a Nursery shop offer so it is kept through a reroll.
Unlocking a shop offer, buying an additional Nursery plot, or unlocking a squad slot.
Planting a stock spore or planting a fresh common mushroom in an empty Nursery plot.
Successfully applying fertilizer to a plot, either from stock or directly from the shop.
Successfully applying a mutation to a plot, either from stock or directly from the shop.
Harvesting ready mushrooms into the troop, and receiving the confirmed starter package at the beginning of a run.
Confirming training successfully places a unit into its pupation cocoon.
Successfully composting a unit after confirming the action.
Successfully adding the confirmed Seal to the run.
Starting a regular non-blunt melee attack, shared by player and enemy units. Great weapons use their dedicated heavier swings. Contact uses a separate hit cue.
Starting a regular blunt melee attack, shared by player and enemy units. Great Hammer and Great Shield use Great swing.
Launching a regular Bow or Crossbow projectile. Great Bow uses its own heavier bowstring release.
The default launch for regular thrown weapons, mortar shots and enemy projectiles. Great Spear has its own heavier throw.
A charging unit begins its charge run.
Positive non-blunt damage on a unit. Direct Great weapon contacts have a dedicated impact; mitigated hits use Block.
Positive blunt damage on a unit, or regular damage to a wall. Direct Great weapon contacts have dedicated impacts; mitigated hits use Block.
Damage is reduced on a unit, or a projectile is intercepted. Great Shield damage reduction uses Great block.
A player or enemy unit begins dying.
An unspent projectile reaches the ground, before sticking or arming an explosive fuse.
An explosive projectile or Boom Cap detonates, or a wall is destroyed.
A fallen adult successfully generates a spore for the Nursery.
A Zombie Cap revival successfully spawns the returning unit.
The battlefield Acid Rain phase starts. This is an onset cue, not a continuous rain loop.
Combat starts, including combat sandbox encounters.
A battle resolves as a victory. A final run victory also has its own result-screen cue.
Starting a Great Sword attack or a Great Spear close-range melee attack.
Starting a Great Hammer attack or a Great Shield bash. Shield damage remains slashing; only the sound changes.
Launching the Great Bow homing arrow, with a heavier bowstring release.
Launching a Great Spear in its ranged attack mode.
An unmitigated Great Sword, Great Spear or Great Bow contact. Also used for their direct hits on walls and flag bearers.
An unmitigated Great Hammer, Great Shield or Great Horn contact. Also used for their direct hits on walls and flag bearers.
A unit equipped with Great Shield reduces incoming damage. Projectile interception retains its usual block cue.
